newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends flat in active market.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends flat in active market.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed flat at 42.8150/8250 to the dollar in interbank trading on Tuesday, despite increased dollar purchases by importers, dealers said.
They said simultaneous offers of U.S. dollars from a large state-owned bank and foreign banks helped offset the importer demand and kept the local unit stable.
The taka was quoted in a wide range of 42.8100 to 42.8300 in early trade but deals centred mostly around the 42.8200 level.
The interbank call money rates ended at 7.75 to 8.5 percent, down from the previous close of 9.25-9.50 percent.
